facebook.caption: Tourists walk straight past this. Sùng Hưng Cổ Tự sits right on Đường Trần Hưng Đạo and most visitors never stop. One of Phu Quoc's oldest temples. Free to enter. Incense in the air, dragon carvings on every column, and almost no one else inside. That's the whole point. Save this for your Phu Quoc trip.
